Name: core_i.id_stage_i.deassert_we
Attack Scenarios: A transient fault on core_i.id_stage_i.deassert_we can perturb CSR-operation suppression -> core_i.csr_op, producing an unintended value, enable, or transition at csr_we_int.
Justification: The CSR-write suppression control directly forces operations to READ; a fault can create or suppress an internal CSR write.

Name: core_i.data_misaligned
Structural Path: core_i.data_misaligned -> ID/EX hold/flush control -> core_i.csr_op -> csr_we_int
Attack Scenarios: A transient fault on core_i.data_misaligned can perturb ID/EX hold/flush control -> core_i.csr_op, producing an unintended value, enable, or transition at csr_we_int.
Justification: The misalignment exception suppresses or redirects writeback; a fault can therefore create or remove an internal CSR write.

Name: core_i.csr_op
Attack Scenarios: A transient fault on core_i.csr_op can perturb CSR operation decode, producing an unintended value, enable, or transition at core_i.cs_registers_i.csr_we_int.
Justification: The core CSR operation code directly qualifies csr_we_int and exhibited near-unity joint fault susceptibility.

Name: core_i.id_stage_i.decoder_i.csr_op
Structural Path: decoder_i.csr_op -> ID-stage CSR control -> core_i.csr_op -> csr_we_int
Attack Scenarios: A transient fault on core_i.id_stage_i.decoder_i.csr_op can perturb ID-stage CSR control -> core_i.csr_op, producing an unintended value, enable, or transition at csr_we_int.
Justification: The decoder's CSR classification feeds the write-enable chain and showed high feasibility with limited masking.

Name: core_i.id_stage_i.csr_op
Structural Path: id_stage_i.csr_op -> ID/EX CSR-operation register -> core_i.csr_op -> csr_we_int
Attack Scenarios: A transient fault on core_i.id_stage_i.csr_op can perturb ID/EX CSR-operation register -> core_i.csr_op, producing an unintended value, enable, or transition at csr_we_int.
Justification: This qualified decode-stage operation is captured into the ID/EX pipeline; a fault can convert a read into a write before commit.

Name: core_i.id_ready
Attack Scenarios: A transient fault on core_i.id_ready can perturb ID/EX advancement -> core_i.csr_op, producing an unintended value, enable, or transition at csr_we_int.
Justification: ID readiness controls pipeline acceptance of the CSR operation; faults propagated strongly to csr_we_int.

Name: core_i.ex_ready
Attack Scenarios: A transient fault on core_i.ex_ready can perturb pipeline advancement -> core_i.csr_op, producing an unintended value, enable, or transition at csr_we_int.
Justification: Execution readiness controls CSR instruction advance and can mis-time or suppress the internal write enable.

Name: core_i.id_stage_i.illegal_insn_dec
Structural Path: illegal_insn_dec -> controller deassert_we -> CSR-operation suppression -> core_i.csr_op -> csr_we_int
Attack Scenarios: A transient deassertion of illegal_insn_dec during an illegal CSR instruction prevents write cancellation and can create csr_we_int.
Justification: Restored by mechanism-led review because this bit is the canonical illegal-CSR rejection boundary immediately upstream of deassert_we and CSR-operation suppression.

Name: core_i.id_stage_i.decoder_i.current_priv_lvl_i
Structural Path: current_priv_lvl_i -> CSR privilege comparison -> csr_illegal/illegal_insn_dec -> deassert_we -> csr_op -> csr_we_int
Attack Scenarios: A transient privilege-level fault during CSR decode can make a user-mode access appear machine-authorized, suppressing the illegal-instruction response and allowing csr_we_int.
Justification: Restored because the signal is a direct operand of the CSR authorization comparison. Its absence from the extracted candidate cohort is not negative threat evidence.

Name: core_i.debug_mode
Structural Path: debug_mode -> debug-only CSR authorization -> csr_illegal/illegal_insn_dec -> deassert_we -> csr_op -> csr_we_int
Attack Scenarios: A transient assertion of debug_mode during a debug-CSR instruction bypasses the debug-only access check and permits an otherwise rejected internal CSR write.
Justification: Restored because debug_mode is the explicit security gate for debug CSR accesses and a single-cycle fault has a direct, address-conditioned path to csr_we_int.
